nodes.label: Tiswell PWA Icon 192px
nodes.rationale: The small-size member of the PWA manifest icon set: the concentric arc mark on an opaque cream square, sized for home-screen shortcuts and browser tab or task-switcher chrome. At this resolution the three outer rings compress toward each other and the dark smile is the only element still individually legible, which is exactly what the darkening colour ramp was built to guarantee.
